sources.title: Define success criteria and build evaluations

folds.title: Evals
points: An **evaluation**, or eval, is a repeatable test of how good AI output is.
You can run it again after every change.

folds.title: Decide what good means
points: "Gets the sentiment right" can be checked.

folds.title: Test like real use
points: Build tests that mirror real use.
Include odd cases too: very long input, unclear requests, and things people should not ask.

folds.title: Grade automatically
points: Use an exact match, a code check, or another model as the grader.
Use a different model from the one that wrote the answer.

folds.title: A tiny eval
points: **Task:** label each review positive or negative.
**Result:** 94 right. Change the prompt, run it again, compare.

folds.title: More beats perfect
points: More tests, even roughly graded, beat a few perfect ones.
Judge several things at once, such as accuracy, tone and speed.

folds.question: Which success criterion is the best one?
options: Correct label on nearly every item in a labelled test set
folds.why: It is specific and measurable, so you can test it again and again.
